description: This source file implements an example application for transmitting Synchronization Signal Blocks (SSB) over a radio interface, integrating upper and lower physical layers with real-time radio hardware or virtual interfaces like ZMQ. It includes configuration profiles, radio setup, signal processing, and control flow for a radio-based SSB transmission demo.
